notes: Every task fixture uses the real MPE triage input contract (contracts/TRIAGE_INPUT.schema.json) and the shapes already used by tests/test_execution_runner.py.
Every failure case names a real gate_id from gates/registry.yaml; no gate is invented and none is edited.
The event-log fixture is a real committed MPE artifact from EXP-27 CP-04, used read-only.
The planted token is a synthetic string used only to prove that failure classification never copies exception detail text into evidence.
